name: Langfuse
oneLine: Open-source LLM observability, evaluation and prompt management platform, available as cloud or self-hosted.

selfHostStack.value: Web and worker containers plus PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis/Valkey and S3-compatible blob storage

selfHostLicence.value: MIT except ee/ (commercial licence); docs mark org creators, instance management API, UI customization as EE

cloudFree.value: Hobby: free, 50k units/month, 30 days data access, 2 users, 2 alerts

cloudPaidFrom.value: Core: $29/month incl. 100k units, then $8 per 100k units (traces, observations and scores count as units)

otel.value: OTLP over HTTP (JSON, protobuf) at /api/public/otel; no gRPC; aims for OTel GenAI conventions, maps others

sql.value: Not documented: docs describe a JSON Metrics API, SDK query access and blob storage export

mcp.value: Native MCP server (Streamable HTTP, Basic auth with project keys); read and write tools, e.g. prompts and observations

onlineEvals.value: Yes: rules run LLM-as-a-judge evaluators on incoming observations; self-hosted worker runs them

datasetsExperiments.value: Yes: datasets and experiments via UI, SDKs or OpenTelemetry

promptManagement.value: Yes: prompt versioning with labels and client-side caching

gateway.value: AI Gateway in public beta: proxy for OpenAI and Anthropic calls with tracing, cost tracking, budgets

alerts.value: Slack, PagerDuty, signed webhooks and GitHub Actions; no email listed; self-hosted v4+ has no alert limit

chooseThem: Large set of framework integrations and a documented feature set
Prompt management, annotation queues and playground with SDK caching
Self-hosting documented for Docker Compose and Kubernetes, using ClickHouse for analytics
Managed cloud with EU and US regions and tiered retention
notes: Langfuse repo is ClickHouse-owned per LICENSE copyright line. 'No SQL' is an absence finding: the docs I read do not mention SQL; low-risk but not an explicit denial. MCP trace tools not confirmed on the page read (observations and prompts are). Pricing page does not name the self-host licence; LICENSE file does. Pricing may change; Enterprise listed at $2,499/month. Verified 2026-11-20: removed unverified 'community support' from cloudFree; sql reworded to 'Not documented'; chooseThem trimmed (dropped unverified Japan/HIPAA regions, 'large user base', 'mature'); other facts confirmed (LICENSE ClickHouse copyright, compose images checked locally). MCP trace tools not confirmed on page.
chooseUs: You want to self-host without running ClickHouse, Redis and blob storage next to it
You want SQL over your traces in the UI, the API and MCP
